about_the_game:
Waifu Weave

I've Died and Been Reincarnated in a Card Game!

You got hit by a meteorite and woke up in a mysterious world where the only way forward is to master the ancient art of Waifu Weave—a strategic card game where victory means everything... and your opponents are charming girls who want to crush you at cards.

🎮 Game Overview

Waifu Weave is a strategic card game inspired by Triple Triad, where you battle a diverse cast of anime waifus on a 3x3 grid. Build your deck, master advanced mechanics, and collect cards from slimes to dragons, from maids to magical girls, and from androids to demons.

🃏 Deep Strategic Gameplay

  • 3x3 Grid Battles: Place cards strategically to flip your opponent's cards

  • Advanced Rules: Master modifiers like Ascension, Descension, Clash, and more!

  • Progressive AI: Face increasingly challenging opponents as you progress through 26 levels

  • Card abilities: Certain cards have special abilities (e.g., Poison, Growth) adding strategic nuance to deck construction

🎴 Extensive Card Collection

Collect over 100 cards and build decks featuring:

  • Slimes of all colors

  • Spiders and their webs

  • Harpies soaring through the peaks

  • Dragons guarding treasure

  • Demons from the abyss

  • Knights in shining armor

  • Maids ready to serve

  • Magical Girls powered by friendship

  • Androids from the future

  • Nagas, Bunnies, Cyclops, and more!

Each card has randomized stats, so no two drops are the same. Find that perfect stat roll!

📈 Card Progression

Cards can gain XP through gameplay and improve their stats permanently. Have duplicate cards? Feed them to your favorites—cannibalize duplicates to power up your best cards and create unstoppable decks!

⭐ Progressive Star System

  • 1 Star: Win the game

  • 2 Stars: Dominate by 2+ cards

  • 3 Stars: Achieve total victory with 3+ card advantage

Stars unlock new levels and more challenging opponents as you weave your way through the world.

🌍 Diverse World & Characters

Explore unique locales from dark caves to enchanted forests, from volcanic calderas to cyberpunk scrapyards. Each opponent has their own personality, deck, and story waiting to be discovered.

🎮 Multiple Game Modifiers

Experience different rule variants that keep gameplay fresh:

  • All Open: All enemy cards are visible

  • Three Open: Only three enemy cards are visible

  • All Closed: All enemy cards are hidden

  • Clash: Cards with a higher tens digit will instantly capture another, but cards with the same tens digit use their ones digit to do battle, with higher ones digits winning more often

  • Ascension/Descension: +5 or -5 for every card of the same family on the board 

🎵 Immersive Experience

  • Dynamic soundtrack of 25 songs

  • Beautiful waifu card artwork

  • Smooth animations, aura affects, and satisfying flip effects

✨ The Journey Begins

Will you emerge victorious and collect them all? Or will you fall to the cunning opponents who stand in your way?

Build your deck. Master the grid. Collect the waifus.

content_descriptors.notes: There are no depictions of sexual acts in this game, but there are plenty of lewd waifus in sexually suggestive poses. There are sometimes voicelines that may be sexually suggestive.
